title: Camps C13 — the shared date picker for Camps’ dates (the camp-days calendar stays)
subtitle: Rule v1.018: Star’s date picker (src/components/DatePicker.jsx) for every date staff pick. In Camps that is Add / Edit camp’s Family sign-up opens, Family sign-up closes and Early price until (section 2, Times), and Edit payment’s Date paid. The pictures show the real shared part, mounted over the page (not a drawing). It opens under the field on PC and tablet and in the page on phones, as in Star. Section 1’s camp-days calendar (several days at once) stays. Amber = what changes.

items.caption: Edit camp, PC 1280×800. The browser’s own date boxes (“05/03/2027” — each browser draws its own calendar).

row.caption: Edit payment (admin): Date paid is a browser box too.

items.caption: PC. Each date is the shared field (“Sun, Jul 4, 2027”); “Family sign-up closes” is open: Month and Year lists, Su–Sa, the chosen day tinted.

row.caption: Phone. The calendar opens in the page under the field, as Star’s does.
Edit payment. Date paid uses the same picker; days after today can’t be picked (as today’s box).

footer: For the build (not a new decision): the pickers take the dialog’s existing rules as gray days where they apply — Date paid: nothing after today (as today); the sign-up dates keep their checks as they are now (opens ≤ closes ≤ last camp day, early price ≤ closes), shown as the field’s amber error line. The 320-wide phone was checked (no sideways scroll). Templates use day counts, not dates, so the template editor has no picker. Script: mock-c13-datepicker.js (mounts the real component with the page’s own React).
